picks.title: Suno-made track 'The Adult I Dreamed Of' is a hit in South Korea
picks.rationale: A second Suno-generated song is now a streaming hit in South Korea, a month after 'Forest of the Heart' entered Melon's Top 100. That makes AI chart success in Korea a pattern rather than a one-off.
picks.excerpt: A Suno-generated song, 'The Adult I Dreamed Of', has become a streaming hit in South Korea, following last month's debate after the AI track 'Forest of the Heart' entered Melon's Top 100.

picks.title: Initial Audio Difro 2: free AI MIDI melody generator, retrained from scratch
picks.rationale: Difro 2 is a new major version with a model retrained from the ground up, and it stays free. Producers can put it straight into a DAW workflow.
picks.excerpt: Initial Audio launches Difro 2, a free AI MIDI melody generator with a model retrained from the ground up, shown in a first-look demo.

picks.title: Line 6 Helix Stadium 1.4 adds on-board stem separation
picks.rationale: Firmware 1.4 puts ML stem separation inside a mainstream guitar processor, so players can isolate parts of a backing track on the unit itself.
picks.excerpt: Line 6 Helix Stadium firmware 1.4 adds new amps and effects plus an on-board stem separation feature that lets guitarists isolate parts of backing tracks.

picks.title: BPB starts filtering low-quality AI-built plugins from its news, opens reader poll
picks.rationale: A major plugin news outlet is changing its editorial policy because of the flood of AI-coded plugins. Developers who rely on BPB coverage will feel that directly.
picks.excerpt: BPB says the flood of plugins built with AI coding tools has lowered average quality and it is now filtering low-quality AI-generated software from its news; a reader poll on AI in music software runs to Oct 20.

picks.title: Gugak-VocalSet: the first public dataset of Korean traditional singing for music AI
picks.rationale: This is the first open dataset of Korean traditional vocals: 24.5 hours from 20 National Gugak Center singers, with sigimsae ornament annotations. It fills a gap for non-Western singing synthesis and transcription.
picks.excerpt: Gugak-VocalSet: the first public dataset of Korean traditional singing (24.5h, 305 tracks, 20 professional singers via the National Gugak Center) with dense sigimsae pitch-ornament annotations for music AI.
